HOW TO PAY TAXES IN CLAY COUNTY
In Person
Monday – Friday at either location during business hours. We accept cash, checks, and cards.
Online
Click here to review payment fees. Return to the billing portal the next business day to get your receipt.
Online Bill Pay
Pay through your bank: include your parcel number on the check and submit a separate payment for each parcel.
By Mail
When paying by mail, please allow plenty of time for postal processing. We will honor USPS postmark dates.
Outdoor Drop Boxes
Available 24/7 at both office locations and emptied daily. Your receipt will be mailed to you, or can be accessed online.
